title: Could It Happen Here? Synthetic pump fire, 2024
audience: HSE managers at the organisation's other sites
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: A pump seal fitted without a specification went back into service untested: check your sites for the same two conditions.

items.text: A self-assessment for each site. Results show coverage and conditions, never a ranking of sites.
The HSE lead at each site answers every self-check on the return: present, partly, absent or n/a, with the site's response and the assessor's role.

items.condition: A pump seal is replaced with a part that has no written specification.
items.evidence_to_check: Seal purchases in the last year each match a specification on file.
items.look_in: Purchase records and the stores catalogue

items.condition: A pump goes back into service after seal work without a leak test.
items.evidence_to_check: Work orders after seal work each carry a signed leak-test record.
items.look_in: Work orders and the return-to-service procedure

items.condition: The restart of a repaired pump does not depend on a test record.
items.evidence_to_check: The restart permit asks for the test record before the pump runs.

items.text: The organisation brings the returns into one view of coverage and conditions; it never scores a site.

limits: The synthetic export describes one site only; the pack says nothing about another site until it answers.
